title: Product of Array Except Self
description: Given an integer array `nums`, return an array `answer` such that `answer[i]` is equal to the product of all elements of `nums` except `nums[i]`, without division in O(n).
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` integers.
hints: Break down the product into prefix products and suffix products.
First compute prefix products up to i - 1 in the result array.
Then sweep from right to left, multiplying by suffix products.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    res = [1] * n
    pref = 1
    for i in range(n):
        res[i] = pref
        pref *= nums[i]
    suff = 1
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        res[i] *= suff
        suff *= nums[i]
    print(' '.join(map(str, res)))
